description: This Java source file defines an Android activity called AnimationCloning, which demonstrates animation cloning and bouncing balls animation. It includes an inner class MyAnimationView that manages drawing and animating multiple animated shapes.

classes.name: AnimationCloning
classes.description: Main activity class that initializes animation view and start button.

classes.name: AnimationCloning$MyAnimationView
classes.description: Custom view class that handles drawing and animating multiple shape objects.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, adds the animation view, and sets up the start button click listener.

methods.name: createAnimation
methods.description: Creates and clones animations for balls to animate vertically with bounce effect.

methods.name: addBall
methods.description: Creates a new ball shape with gradient fill at specified position and adds it to the list.

methods.name: onAnimationUpdate
methods.description: Redraws the view on each animation update.
